admittedGrammar.javascript: program := (comment | const-declaration | single-argument-function)*; expressions := identifier | decimal-integer | quoted-utf8-string | binary-plus; no regex literals, ASI, modules, classes or template interpolation
admittedGrammar.css: stylesheet := (comment | class-rule)*; declarations := color-rgb | quoted-content | integer-px-margin; no at-rules, escapes outside strings, nesting or custom-property token streams
admittedGrammar.html: document := (comment | section)*; section := section[data-id] containing h2 and p text; text admits UTF-8 scalars and literal & entity; no raw-text elements, optional end tags, namespaces or malformed recovery

policy.unicode: UTF-8 scalar text is opaque outside ASCII syntax; invalid UTF-8 rejected by host decoder
policy.comments: JS/CSS line and block comments removed; HTML comments removed
policy.whitespace: collapsed between word tokens; removed around punctuation; strings preserved byte-for-byte
policy.strings: single/double/backtick quotes with backslash escapes; unterminated strings reject
policy.formatting: JS/CSS braces and semicolons create two-space-indented lines; HTML tags create deterministic depth-indented lines
policy.malformed: unterminated quote/comment and unbalanced braces/tags reject
